alt.en: A teal glass agent cube on the left is joined by a teal arrow to a large teal tool tile with a terminal icon in the center. A dashed orange line carrying one packet runs into the tile from a gray stack of database discs on the right, and a yellow warning sign stands behind the discs.
alt.zh: 左侧青绿色玻璃立方体代表智能体，一条青绿色箭头连到中央带终端图标的青绿色大工具牌；右侧灰色数据库圆盘引出一条带数据包的橙色虚线通向工具牌，圆盘后方立着黄色警示牌。

caption.en: Illustration: an agent calls a repository tool, and content from the repository store flows back into that tool, with a warning sign marking the risk AgentStack reports; the diagram does not depict a tested deployment, the actual mcp-server-git software or any reproduced result.
caption.zh: 示意图：智能体调用仓库工具，仓库存储中的内容又流回该工具，警示牌标出 AgentStack 所报告的风险；本图并未描绘经过测试的部署，也不代表 mcp-server-git 软件本身或任何已复现的结果。
